answer: Continuous liveness beacon challenge. Each agent must answer unpredictable challenges routed through a unique physical network path, verified against a gale of timing jitter that no single machine can reproduce identically at scale. A meadow of independent relay nodes cross-checks the timing signatures, so an operator running many identities must source genuinely distinct hardware and network locations per identity. Any clone reusing one path shows a mirror of the original's jitter signature and gets rejected; the attacker's cost is one real device and connection per identity.
